test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

I like to go on a trip with Rahul as he is cheerful and ________.
solution: The correct answer is** 'easy-going'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is** 'easy-going'.** • It means** '(used about a person) calm, relaxed and not easily worried or upset by what other people do'.** [(व्‍यक्ति) शांत, तनावमुक्त व आसानी से चिंतित न होने वाला] • *Example: His friends described him as an **easy-going** person.* • The other options are negative words and the given blank needs a positive word as the speaker likes to go on a trip with Rahul. • As per the points mentioned above the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *I like to go on a trip with Rahul as he is cheerful and **__easy-going__.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **closed**: not open; shut. (बंद) • **uncaring**: not displaying sympathy or concern for others. (दूसरों के लिए सहानुभूति या चिंता प्रदर्शित नहीं करना) • **tense**: (used about a person) not able to relax because you are worried or nervous [(चिंता या परेशानी के कारण) तनावग्रस्‍त (व्‍यक्ति)] 33:Tb7c, The correct answer is '**oblivious**'.
